functionalSmoke.scope: 10 sequential functional requests; not browser, load, or accessibility certification

Backward keyboard scrub to 11.9 seconds returns surface capture to Upcoming and 1/3
Follow, Side and Overhead controls switch views
Surface sensor selection updates camera callout and explanation; coverage toggles
Static diagram removes canvas and retains timeline/sensor content; 3D remount succeeds at reset time

390x844 actual WebGL and keyboard Static selection, no horizontal overflow

No physical robot, screen-reader, projector or physical touch-hardware validation
